objective.title: The objective
objective.description: Work together to put the numbers in the correct order.

receiveNumber.title: Receive your number
receiveNumber.description:
When starting a round, each player receives a secret number and a color.

The higher the number, the more your answer should represent the upper end of the scale. The lower the number, the closer it should be to the lower end.

thinkPhrase.title: Think about the phrase
thinkPhrase.description:
A phrase will be presented to all players.

Example: "How tasty is this food?"

1 → something you would never eat
100 → your favorite food

IMPORTANT
Do not reveal your answer

discoverOrder.title: Discover the order
discoverOrder.description:
After everyone answers:

Listen to each other's answers
Discuss as a group
Try to discover the correct position of each player

The goal is to build the number sequence without anyone revealing their value.

reveal.title: Reveal
reveal.description:
When the group is ready:

Confirm the chosen sequence
Reveal the numbers
Find out if the order is correct

   If all players are in the correct position, the round is won!

orderingPage.sortChoicesInstruction:

The numbers must be from highest to lowest.
